d:
Bloomberg Economics Analyst Alex Kokcharov tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump’s historic meeting with Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping produced limited concrete results despite a joint declaration on energy, nuclear risks and other global issues. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kokcharov explains what Trump’s relationship with Putin means for Ukraine as Europe takes on more of Kyiv’s support and the war intensifies after Ukraine’s latest attack on the Crimean Bridge.
